name: Morpheus8 Burst

lead: Morpheus8 Burst is the Burst-mode, deeper-reaching configuration of InMode's RF microneedling device. It is marketed for firmer skin, better texture and mild fat reduction, particularly around the lower face, jawline and neck.

Insulated needles penetrate the skin and release radiofrequency energy at chosen depths, heating tissue to prompt collagen remodeling. Research on the Burst mode specifically is minimal; one registered trial looked at multi-depth RF microneedling for cellulite.

paras: It is a clinic treatment, usually done as a series of sessions weeks apart, with results said to build gradually as collagen remodels. Treatment depth is set by the provider for the area.
Redness, swelling and pinpoint bleeding are common after treatment. Burns, scarring, infection and pigment changes are described as rarer risks. It is a clinic-only procedure.

angle.text: Burst mode sends RF energy deeper into the skin to prompt collagen remodeling and mild fat reduction, aiming for firmer skin and a tighter jawline. It is promoted for the lower face and neck, with minimal published research on this setting.

lead: Morpheus8 Burst refers to the Burst mode and deeper attachments of the Morpheus8 radiofrequency (RF) microneedling system from InMode, which uses insulated microneedles to deliver bipolar RF energy into the dermis and subdermal tissue [1]. It is marketed for skin laxity, texture and mild fat remodeling.
Published independent evidence specific to the Burst mode is minimal. The registered trial that applies to this entry tested multi-depth RF microneedling for cellulite [2].

paras: An AI-generated encyclopedia entry describes Morpheus8 as delivering bipolar RF through insulated needles in Burst mode, with tips ranging from superficial resurfacing pins to deeper subdermal tips and a Burst deep-body attachment, and treatment depths adjustable from 0.5 to 8 mm [1]. That account is untrusted and not independently verified here.

A 48-person registered study evaluated RF microneedling with multi-depth targeting per insertion for cellulite of the leg [2]. No further studies specific to the Burst mode were identified. The same Grokipedia source states that many Morpheus8 studies are industry-sponsored and that independent data beyond 12 months is limited [1].

The Grokipedia entry lists temporary redness, swelling and pinpoint bleeding as common effects and burns, scarring, infection and pigment changes as rarer risks, and states the FDA has flagged risks of RF microneedling devices [1].
